senses.en: a brief social visit

senses.en: a request

not many calls for buggywhips

senses.en: a visit in an official or professional capacity

examples.en: the pastor's calls on his parishioners
examples.zh: 牧师对他的教友们的呼唤

examples.en: the salesman's call on a customer

senses.en: (sports) the decision made by an umpire or referee
senses.zh: (体育)裁判员或裁判员作出的决定

examples.en: he was ejected for protesting the call
examples.zh: 他因抗议电话而被开除

senses.en: the option to buy a given stock (or stock index or commodity future) at a given price before a given date
senses.zh: 在某一日期之前以某一价格购买某一股票(或股票指数或商品未来)的选择

senses.en: assign a specified (usually proper) proper name to
senses.zh: 指定一个指定(通常是适当的)适当名称给

examples.en: They named their son David

examples.zh: 新学校以著名的民权领袖命名

senses.zh: 给一个反映质量的通用名词写一个质量或给一个名称

examples.en: He called me a bastard

examples.zh: 她称她的孩子懒惰 忘恩负义

senses.en: get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
senses.zh: 通过电话获得或试图与他人联系

examples.en: I tried to call you all night
examples.zh: 我整晚都在试着给你打电话。

examples.en: Take two aspirin and call me in the morning
examples.zh: 服两片阿司匹林，明早给我打电话。（词典例句，不是用药建议。）

senses.en: utter a sudden loud cry
senses.zh: 突然大叫起来

examples.en: she cried with pain when the doctor inserted the needle
I yelled to her from the window but she couldn't hear me
examples.zh: 我从窗户对着她大吼大叫,但她听不到我

senses.en: order, request, or command to come
senses.zh: 命令、请求或命令来

examples.en: She was called into the director's office
examples.zh: 她被叫进局长办公室了

examples.en: Call the police!

senses.en: pay a brief visit
senses.zh: 做个短暂的访问

examples.en: The mayor likes to call on some of the prominent citizens
examples.zh: 市长喜欢召见一些著名市民

senses.en: call a meeting; invite or command to meet
senses.zh: 召集会议;邀请或命令召开会议

examples.en: The Wannsee Conference was called to discuss the `Final Solution'
examples.zh: 万恩赛会议被召集来讨论“最终解决方案”

examples.en: The new dean calls meetings every week

senses.en: read aloud to check for omissions or absentees
senses.zh: 大声读取以检查遗漏或缺席者

examples.en: Call roll

senses.en: send a message or attempt to reach someone by radio, phone, etc.; make a signal to in order to transmit a message

examples.en: Hawaii is calling!
A transmitter in Samoa was heard calling
examples.zh: 在萨摩亚听到一个发射机呼叫

senses.en: utter a characteristic note or cry
senses.zh: 发出一个特征音符或哭声

examples.en: bluejays called to one another

senses.en: stop or postpone because of adverse conditions, such as bad weather
senses.zh: 由于恶劣天气等不利条件而停止或推迟

examples.en: call a football game

senses.en: greet, as with a prescribed form, title, or name
senses.zh: 以规定的形式、标题或名称向您致意

examples.zh: 他总是用"先生"对我说话

examples.en: Call me Mister

senses.en: make a stop in a harbour
senses.zh: 在港湾停靠

examples.en: The ship will call in Honolulu tomorrow
examples.zh: 船明天会叫火奴鲁鲁来

senses.en: demand payment of (a loan)
senses.zh: 要求付款(贷款)

examples.en: Call a loan

senses.en: make a demand, as for a card or a suit or a show of hands
senses.zh: 要求,如卡片、西装或举手

examples.en: He called his trump

senses.en: give the calls (to the dancers) for a square dance
senses.zh: 请你召人来,请他们跳正舞,

senses.en: indicate a decision in regard to
senses.zh: 说明就

examples.en: call balls and strikes behind the plate
examples.zh: 呼叫球,然后在盘子后面打

senses.en: make a prediction about; tell in advance
senses.zh: 预测; 预告

examples.en: Call the outcome of an election

senses.en: require the presentation of for redemption before maturation
senses.zh: 规定在到期前必须提出赎回要求

examples.en: Call a bond

senses.en: challenge (somebody) to make good on a statement; charge with or censure for an offense
senses.zh: 质疑(某人)在陈述上作好善事;指控或谴责某项罪行;

examples.en: He deserves to be called on that

senses.en: declare in the capacity of an umpire or referee
senses.zh: 以仲裁人或裁判人身份声明

examples.en: call a runner out

senses.en: lure by imitating the characteristic call of an animal
senses.zh: 通过模仿动物的特征召唤来诱骗

examples.en: Call ducks

senses.en: order or request or give a command for
senses.zh: 命令或请求或给出命令

examples.en: The unions called a general strike for Sunday

senses.en: order, summon, or request for a specific duty or activity, work, role
senses.zh: 命令、传讯或要求履行某项具体职责或活动、工作、作用

examples.en: He was already called 4 times for jury duty
examples.zh: 他已经被传召担任陪审员4次了。

examples.en: They called him to active military duty

senses.en: utter in a loud voice or announce
senses.zh: 大声说话或宣布

examples.en: He called my name
The auctioneer called the bids

senses.en: challenge the sincerity or truthfulness of
senses.zh: 质疑其诚意或真实性

examples.en: call the speaker on a question of fact
examples.zh: 给发言人打电话,问一个事实问题

senses.en: consider or regard as being
senses.zh: 考虑或认为存在

examples.en: I would not call her beautiful

senses.en: rouse somebody from sleep with a call
senses.zh: 唤醒别人睡觉的电话

examples.en: I was called at 5 A.M. this morning
examples.zh: 今天早上5点，有人把我叫醒了。
